description: Build a customised packing list from a Wilderness Times checklist: start from an activity, optionally keep only certain categories, drop items that do not apply, and add your own. Returns the tailored list plus buying-guide links for whatever survived. Use this when the user wants a list shaped to their specific trip rather than the full standard one.

activity.description: Base activity. One of: camping, backpacking, hiking, winter-camping, cabin-camping, couples-camping, kayak-camping, motorcycle-camping, toddler-camping, fishing, snowboarding.

add.description: Optional. Extra items to append under a 'Your additions' category.

exclude.description: Optional. Item names to leave out (matched loosely — 'hammock' drops 'Hammock').

name: build_checklist
title: Build a custom packing list
